meta.name: feedback
meta.description: Assess a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context. Use for recurring deployment lessons; distinguish a hypothesis from a validated pattern.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把现场教训整理成可复用的做法或产品反馈,同时隐去客户信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队反复踩同类部署坑,却难把现场经验沉淀成可复用做法。
copy.tagline_en: Turn field lessons into reusable patterns or product feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team keeps hitting the same field issues and struggles to capture lessons.

howto.what: 它把一条现场/部署经验拿去做评估:判断这是可复用的模式,还是该反馈给产品的意见,同时不暴露客户信息,并区分「假设」与「已验证的模式」。动手前会先读任务上下文契约和方法。
howto.when: 当你手头有反复出现的部署经验需要评估时;或被 @fde 调用时,直接沿用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重启设置、不重复已答的问题。

say.text: 帮我评估这条部署经验:该复用,还是反馈给产品?
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约和方法再评估

say.text: 这条经验算已验证的模式,还是只是假设?
say.note: 会区分假设与已验证模式

say.text: 直接用 @fde 的脱敏数据包评估,不用重新开始
say.note: 沿用当前范围与已答问题

howto.what_en: Assesses a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context, and separates a hypothesis from a validated pattern. It reads the task context contract and the method first.
howto.when_en: Use when you have recurring deployment lessons to assess, or when called by @fde — it then reuses the current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Assess this deployment lesson: reuse it or send product feedback?
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: Is this a validated pattern or just a hypothesis?
Reuse the @fde sanitized packet, don't restart setup
